This article is about the upcoming grid of blocks.   For the current grid, see Debug mode/Grid.   For the list of blocks in one table, see Debug mode/Blocks.



This article describes content that is currently in development for Java Edition. 
This content has appeared in  development versions for Java Edition, but the full update adding it has not been released yet.





This feature is exclusive to Java Edition. 



This article is a work in progress. 
Please help expand and improve it. The talk page may contain suggestions.Note: New block states section


This page lists all the rows in the debug mode block grid in Java Edition 26.3 Snapshot 7.
There are 189 lines with up to 190 block states. The last line has 115 block states.
Of these 188, those that appear at the end of a line are repeated at the beginning of the next.
Therefore, there are 35,687 block states in total, with 35,499 unique block states.
The first block is located at coordinates (1, 70, 1) and each block is 2 blocks away from its adjacent blocks, thus the block in row r, column c is at coordinates (2r-1, 70, 2c-1).
